phrases.text: Epic just revealed the real odds of finding Pirate Shop Access. Ready?
One in one hundred thirty seven thousand, five hundred. Per chest, in a normal match.
The weekly gold outfit is even rarer: one in over one and a half million.
A gizmo? One in one hundred twenty seven. That's the common one.
How many chests have you opened this season?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
